purpose: Numeric prosody reference only; never use third-party audio as a voice prompt

reference_summary.delivery: firm conversational attack; mostly falling sentence endings with occasional upward emphasis

hook.direction: front-loaded emphasis; brief pauses 0.1-0.4s; end most phrases falling

solution.direction: slightly slower close; firm falling cadence

application.pitch_control: CosyVoice prompt controls contour; no numeric pitch-shift is applied
application.speed_control: cloneSpeed is the only numeric control; adjust 0.9-1.1 after listening
application.privacy: Reference reels are analyzed numerically only and are never passed as promptAudio

limitations: Instagram SRT text is mojibake, so tempo is a character-rate proxy, not semantic alignment.
F0 uses autocorrelation with an adaptive RMS gate; BGM and low speech_gate_ratio (0.179-0.314) can bias estimates.
User prompt recordings have different durations/text lengths; absolute F0 is not a target for identity cloning.
